title: The Constitution of 1917: land, work and school
goal: Describe the Constitution of 1917 with relative clauses that take a preposition.

items: I can describe a thing or a person with a relative clause such as *en el que* or *para los que*.
I can say what Article 27 says about land and the subsoil.
I can say what Article 123 gave to workers.
I can use the words *la huelga*, *el sindicato*, *la jornada* and *laico*.
